supportblocks.configuration.title: Support Blocks Configuration
supportblocks.configuration.enabledOnSta: Show the outlines right after the game starts.
Also mark your own player (third-person view only, F5).
supportblocks.configuration.seeThroughWa: Show the outlines through walls and other blocks.
supportblocks.configuration.useBlockShap: Outline the real block shape (slabs, stairs, fences, ...) instead of a full cube.
Outline color for players as hex: #RRGGBB or #AARRGGBB.
supportblocks.configuration.targets.tool: PLAYERS = players only, LIVING = players and mobs, ALL = all entities (items, boats, ...).
Fill the block in the outline color (0.0 = no fill).
supportblocks.configuration.hostileColor: Outline color for hostile mobs as hex: #RRGGBB or #AARRGGBB.
supportblocks.configuration.passiveColor: Outline color for passive mobs (animals, villagers, ...) as hex: #RRGGBB or #AARRGGBB.
supportblocks.configuration.otherColor.t: Outline color for all other entities (items, boats, ...) as hex: #RRGGBB or #AARRGGBB.
